data.description: Pompe hydraulique à engrenages pour tracteurs agricoles, 250 bar, corps en fonte
data.facts_summary: Material: cast iron. Use: hydraulic power for agricultural tractors. Process: gear pump.

considered_candidates.rationale: Heading 84136031 covers hydraulic fluid power pumps, which directly matches this gear pump's primary function of providing hydraulic power transmission. The cast iron body and 250 bar rating are typical specifications for hydraulic pumps classified under this heading.

evidence.excerpt: Subject to the operation of note 3 to Section XVI and subject to note 11 to this chapter, a machine or appliance which answers to a description in one or more of the headings 8401 to 8424 , or heading 8486 and at the same time to a description in one or more of the headings 8425 to 8480 is to be classified under the appropriate heading of the former group or under heading 8486 , as the case may be, and not the latter group.

considered_candidates.rationale: Heading 84136061 is another hydraulic fluid power classification that encompasses gear pumps used in power transmission systems. This code is equally applicable to hydraulic pumps serving agricultural machinery.

evidence.excerpt: Subject to the operation of note 3 to Section XVI and subject to note 11 to this chapter, a machine or appliance which answers to a description in one or more of the headings 8401 to 8424 , or heading 8486 and at the same time to a description in one or more of the headings 8425 to 8480 is to be classified under the appropriate heading of the former group or under heading 8486 , as the case may be, and not the latter group.

considered_candidates.rationale: Heading 84135061 covers hydraulic fluid power components and would capture this gear pump as a hydraulic power transmission element. The agricultural tractor application fits within the scope of hydraulic power machinery.

evidence.excerpt: Subject to the operation of note 3 to Section XVI and subject to note 11 to this chapter, a machine or appliance which answers to a description in one or more of the headings 8401 to 8424 , or heading 8486 and at the same time to a description in one or more of the headings 8425 to 8480 is to be classified under the appropriate heading of the former group or under heading 8486 , as the case may be, and not the latter group.

considered_candidates.rationale: Heading 84122981 covers hydraulic fluid power motors, which are devices that consume hydraulic energy. A pump generates hydraulic power rather than consuming it, making this classification incorrect for a pump.

evidence.excerpt: Subject to the operation of note 3 to Section XVI and subject to note 11 to this chapter, a machine or appliance which answers to a description in one or more of the headings 8401 to 8424 , or heading 8486 and at the same time to a description in one or more of the headings 8425 to 8480 is to be classified under the appropriate heading of the former group or under heading 8486 , as the case may be, and not the latter group.

considered_candidates.rationale: Heading 87084050 covers gearboxes, which are transmission components. While this product contains gears, it is a pump (energy generator) not a gearbox (transmission reducer), making this classification inappropriate.

questions.why: Headings within chapter 84 split by the machine's function (pumps, compressors, engines, refrigerating equipment, machine tools, and so on).
